title: Dutch labour inspectorate reviews incident at Northwind customer site
text:
The Netherlands Labour Authority is reviewing an incident in which a warehouse worker was injured at a site in Tilburg that uses robots made by Northwind Robotics, the authority confirmed.

The worker suffered a minor hand injury in September when a robot arm moved while a packing station was being cleared. The worker returned to work the following week.

A spokesperson for the authority said the review was routine after any reported injury involving machinery and that no fault had been established.

Northwind Robotics said it had issued a software update on 9 October that stops the arm whenever the station guard is open, and that it was cooperating with the review.
